headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nick Gonzales leading the offense. Gonzales hit a home run (4) on a fly ball to left center field and finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI. The Cincinnati Reds also secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense, going 3-for-4 with a home run and three RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Jason Adam of the San Diego Padres, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. Mitchell Parker of the Washington Nationals has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. Matt Chapman of the San Francisco Giants has been placed on the 10-day injured list with an abdominal strain.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their roster with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals after being dealt for shortstop Randal Diaz.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 10-run victory. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, coming from behind in the final game. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.
